answer: A stake-bond mechanism: each agent locks 10,000 POA to join the atlas of verified identities. Step 1: deposit bond to a slashing contract. Step 2: peer attestations accumulate reputation weight. Step 3: any sybil detected triggers 3x bond burn — attacker loses $30,000 at current price. Step 4: honest agents earn 8% APY on surviving bonds. The echo of slashing deters armies; a sable cloak hides no thief when the ledger sees all.
